rows.label: tlk42100151_03_msg0001
rows.name:
I met a Phonex from another
country the other day.

rows.label: tlk42100151_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Apparently, the Phonex stowed away on
a Divine Beast ship that arrived at
Port Ananyam.

rows.label: tlk42100151_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I was surprised. The Phonex was about
the same size as me.

rows.label: tlk42100151_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I thought a Phonex raised in Superbia
would be much scrawnier, but this one
was surprisingly about my size.

rows.label: tlk42100151_03_msg0005
rows.name:
We're made to grow well even in
cold or hot places, or places
with little water or plants.
